entry.description: One member's entry. A record lists the entry's commitment: the CID of the entry, without '$type', encoded as DAG-CBOR and hashed with SHA-256. The host keeps entries private, and an attestation that relies on one reveals it.

role.description: The role the record that commits to this entry gives: 'member', 'admin' or 'owner' in an organization's members, 'member' or 'maintainer' in a team, 'publisher' or 'owner' in a package's maintainers.

automation.description: Whether the account is a bot, such as the one CI publishes as.

approvalKeys.description: The member's passkeys or security keys. With any, the member's attestations count only with an approval signed by one.

salt.description: 32 random bytes, so that no one can find a commitment by trying DIDs.
